sentences.en: A pair of bread slices popped up from the toaster.
sentences.zh: 烤面包片从烤面包机里弹了出来。

sentences.en: There were kitchen gadgets including toasters, kettles and percolators.
sentences.zh: 厨房用具包括烤面包机、水壶和咖啡过滤器。

sentences.en: Damn! This toaster tries to make a monkey out of me.
sentences.zh: 该死！这个烤面包机想把我整糊涂。

senses.zh: 烤面包炉；用即兴演讲配以雷盖音乐的主持人
